tools.name: scan_solana_token
tools.title: Scan a Solana Token
tools.description: Run a live, evidence-first Solana token risk scan. Checks mint and freeze authority, top-account concentration, DexScreener discovery, and Jupiter routing. This is technical information, not investment advice.

mint.description: A base58 Solana SPL token mint address.

tools.name: scan_solana_token_public_sector
tools.title: Create a Signed Public-Sector Token Assessment
tools.description: Return a signed, independently verifiable Solana token assessment with PUBLIC data classification, provenance, known limitations, and mandatory human-review metadata. This is an alignment profile, not government approval or certification.

mint.description: A base58 Solana SPL token mint address.

requestId.description: Optional caller trace ID using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

tools.name: list_avora_offers
tools.title: List AVORA Evidence Offers
tools.description: Compare current AVORA evidence products, prices, scope, and safety boundaries before creating an order.

tools.name: create_starter_snapshot_order
tools.title: Create a 1 USDC Signed Snapshot Order
tools.description: Create a unique Solana Pay request for a 1 USDC signed risk snapshot covering one mint. No funds move until the user explicitly approves the request in a wallet.

mint.description: The Solana SPL token mint to assess.

tools.name: create_pro_report_order
tools.title: Create a Pro Report Order
tools.description: Create a unique Solana Pay request for a 9 USDC Pro Evidence Packet covering one mint. Creating the request does not move funds; the user must explicitly approve and sign in their wallet.

mint.description: The Solana SPL token mint to analyze.

campaign.description: Optional attribution code using letters, numbers, underscore, or hyphen.

tools.name: create_portfolio_report_order
tools.title: Create a Portfolio Report Order
tools.description: Create a unique Solana Pay request for a 49 USDC comparative due-diligence packet covering 2-10 Solana token mints. No funds move until the user approves the request in a wallet.

mints.description: Two to ten unique Solana SPL token mint addresses.

tools.name: verify_starter_snapshot_payment
tools.title: Verify Payment and Deliver Signed Snapshot
tools.description: Verify a previously created 1 USDC Solana Pay order and return a timestamped signed risk snapshot. Recipient, token, amount, reference, product hash, campaign memo, and payment age are validated.

tools.name: verify_pro_report_payment
tools.title: Verify Payment and Deliver Report
tools.description: Verify a previously created 9 USDC Solana Pay order and return the signed Pro Evidence Packet. Recipient, token, amount, reference, product hash, campaign memo, and payment age are validated.

orderId.description: The order ID returned at creation.

campaign.description: The campaign returned at order creation.

requestId.description: Optional trace ID for the signed report.

tools.name: verify_portfolio_report_payment
tools.title: Verify Payment and Deliver Portfolio Report
tools.description: Verify a 49 USDC portfolio order and return comparative evidence, ranked risks, decision checklists, and signed assessments for 2-10 mints.

tools.name: get_avora_service_info
tools.title: Get AVORA Service Information
tools.description: Return the public AVORA Agent Forge site, API, MCP endpoint, AVRA mint, pricing, and safety boundaries.

tools.name: get_verified_revenue_status
tools.title: Get Verified Revenue and Conversion Status
tools.description: Return aggregate AVORA Agent Forge scans, orders, deliveries, and verified onchain USDC revenue for the last 1-90 days. No wallet, mint, IP, or user identifiers are returned.
